description: Connect a Gmail mailbox of a Google Workspace domain through domain-wide delegation - no password and no sign-in by the person. Requires that the customer's Workspace admin authorised our service account (docu/google-workspace-postfaecher.md) and that the domain is enabled for this tenant (set_integration_credentials provider google_workspace, credentials.domains). Verifies by reading the person's Gmail profile before saving. An existing mailbox with the same address (password or OAuth) is switched over instead of duplicated. owner_user_id: whose mailbox it is (default: the caller); setting up someone else's needs the admin role.

owner_user_id.description: User id of the person the mailbox belongs to. Default: the caller.

services.description: Also connect these services of the same person through the delegation (calendar, Meet transcripts, Drive with write access). Result per service; one may fail without the others.

name: add_workspace_mailbox
